objects.description: Opaque/dummy list item type that matches size/alignment of the internal FreeRTOS list item (for static allocation scaffolding). Do not access members; layout varies with configuration macros.
Opaque/dummy mini list item matching the internal FreeRTOS mini list head item. Either a dedicated struct or an alias of StaticListItem_t depending on config.
Opaque/dummy list container that matches size/alignment of the kernel’s internal List_t for static allocation and sizing. Fields are placeholders; not for direct use.
Opaque/dummy Task Control Block used to statically allocate tasks with xTaskCreateStatic or related APIs. Matches the internal TCB size/alignment under all configurations. Do not access members.
Opaque/dummy queue object used to statically allocate queues, semaphores, and mutexes. StaticSemaphore_t is an alias for StaticQueue_t. Not for direct member access.
Opaque/dummy event group object used for static allocation of event groups; guarantees size/alignment compatibility with the kernel’s internal event group type.
Opaque/dummy software timer object for static allocation of timers. Sized to match the internal timer structure. Do not access members.
Opaque/dummy stream buffer object for static allocation of stream buffers; also used for message buffers via the StaticMessageBuffer_t alias. Layout mirrors internal kernel type for sizing only.

objects.definition: struct tskTaskControlBlock; /* The old naming convention is used to prevent breaking kernel aware debuggers. */
objects.description: Opaque Task Control Block (TCB) type used internally by the kernel. Applications reference tasks via TaskHandle_t/ConstTaskHandle_t, which are pointers to this incomplete type. The full definition is intentionally hidden from public headers.

objects.definition:
typedef struct tskTaskControlBlock         * TaskHandle_t;
typedef const struct tskTaskControlBlock   * ConstTaskHandle_t;
objects.description: Handle type for RTOS tasks. It is a pointer to the opaque TCB structure. Use TaskHandle_t to refer to tasks from API calls; ConstTaskHandle_t is a pointer to const TCB for read-only contexts.

objects.definition: typedef BaseType_t (* TaskHookFunction_t)( void * arg );
objects.description: Function pointer typedef for per-task application hook functions. The hook is invoked with a void* argument and returns a BaseType_t status.
Enumeration of task run-time states as returned by eTaskGetState and used in task status reporting.
Enumeration of actions applied to a task notification value when a notification is sent.
Time capture structure used internally and by APIs like vTaskSetTimeOutState/xTaskCheckForTimeOut to track tick count and overflows across waits.
Describes a single MPU memory region: base address, length in bytes, and attribute/permission parameters.

Parameter block for creating an MPU-protected or restricted task. Includes entry function, name, stack depth, parameters, priority, optional provided stack buffer, MPU regions, and optionally a StaticTask_t TCB buffer when static allocation is enabled.
Snapshot of a task’s status used by trace/stats APIs, including handle, name, numeric id, state, priorities, run-time counter, stack info, and optionally core affinity.
Enumeration returned by eTaskConfirmSleepModeStatus indicating whether sleep should be aborted, standard, or that no tasks are waiting for timeouts (if enabled).

Opaque FreeRTOS kernel object representing the internal queue/semaphore/mutex structure. This header only forward-declares the struct; its layout is private to the kernel. Three public handle typedefs alias pointers to this same opaque type: QueueHandle_t for queues/semaphores/mutexes; QueueSetHandle_t for queue-set handles; QueueSetMemberHandle_t for members (queues or semaphores) of a queue set.

objects.definition: typedef QueueHandle_t SemaphoreHandle_t;
objects.description: Alias type for a semaphore handle in FreeRTOS. It is typedef’d to QueueHandle_t, reflecting that semaphores are implemented on top of queues. Used to reference binary, counting, and mutex semaphores.

Referenced as the storage type for statically allocated semaphores and mutexes. This header does not define StaticSemaphore_t; it is only referenced here, so its full definition is unknown in this file.

objects.definition:
struct EventGroupDef_t;
typedef struct EventGroupDef_t   * EventGroupHandle_t;
objects.description: Opaque handle type for a FreeRTOS event group. It is a pointer to an internal event group structure whose definition is hidden from users. Used with the Event Groups API to create, manipulate, and delete event groups. Details of the underlying structure are intentionally not exposed in this header.

objects.definition: typedef TickType_t               EventBits_t;
objects.description: Type used to hold the bit flags within an event group. Its width matches TickType_t and depends on configTICK_TYPE_WIDTH_IN_BITS. Used as parameters and return values indicating sets of event flags.

objects.definition: struct StreamBufferDef_t;
objects.description: Opaque/incomplete struct that represents a FreeRTOS stream (and message/batching) buffer control block. Only a forward declaration is present in this header; the structure layout is private to the kernel. Users interact with it via the handle typedef.

objects.definition: typedef struct StreamBufferDef_t * StreamBufferHandle_t;
objects.description: Public handle type used to reference a stream/message/batching buffer object. It is an opaque pointer to an internal StreamBufferDef_t. All public Stream Buffer APIs accept or return this handle.

Function pointer type for optional stream/message/batching buffer callbacks that notify send/receive completion. Called with the buffer handle, a flag indicating ISR context, and an out-param to request a context switch.

objects.definition: typedef StreamBufferHandle_t MessageBufferHandle_t;
objects.description: Opaque handle type used to reference a FreeRTOS message buffer. It is an alias of StreamBufferHandle_t because message buffers are implemented on top of stream buffers. Being a handle, its concrete structure is not exposed here and must be managed via the message buffer API. Note: actual object lifetime is controlled by the create/delete functions/macros; the underlying type definition resides in stream_buffer.h.

objects.definition:
struct tmrTimerControl; /* The old naming convention is used to prevent breaking kernel aware debuggers. */
typedef struct tmrTimerControl * TimerHandle_t;
objects.description: Opaque software timer control block used by FreeRTOS to represent a software timer. Only a forward declaration is provided here; the structure is defined privately in the kernel. Applications manipulate timers via the TimerHandle_t handle and related API functions. Details of fields and lifetime management are internal to the kernel.

objects.definition: typedef void (* TimerCallbackFunction_t)( TimerHandle_t xTimer );
objects.description: Function pointer type for software timer callback functions. The function is invoked by the timer daemon task when the timer expires. The sole parameter is the timer handle that expired.

objects.definition:
typedef void (* PendedFunction_t)( void * arg1,
                                   uint32_t arg2 );
objects.description: Function pointer type for functions deferred to the timer/daemon task using xTimerPendFunctionCall or xTimerPendFunctionCallFromISR. Accepts an opaque pointer and a 32-bit value.

objects.definition: typedef void * CoRoutineHandle_t;
objects.description: Opaque handle type for a FreeRTOS co-routine control block. It is a void* typedef used by the public co-routine API to reference a co-routine instance without exposing its structure.

objects.definition:
typedef void (* crCOROUTINE_CODE)( CoRoutineHandle_t xHandle,
                                   UBaseType_t uxIndex );
objects.description: Function pointer type that defines the signature of a co-routine function: it takes a CoRoutineHandle_t and an index parameter. Used when creating co-routines and stored in the control block.

Co-routine Control Block for FreeRTOS co-routines. Stores the co-routine entry function, scheduling list links, priority, index, and the internal state used by the co-routine macros. Instances are managed internally by the co-routine scheduler; application code refers to them via CoRoutineHandle_t.

Node type used by FreeRTOS intrusive lists. Stores sort key xItemValue, forward/back links, back-pointer to owning object (pvOwner), and the container list (pxContainer). MiniListItem_t is either a reduced node used for list end marker when configUSE_MINI_LIST_ITEM==1, or an alias of xLIST_ITEM otherwise.
Doubly-linked list container used by the FreeRTOS scheduler. Tracks number of items, iteration index (pxIndex), and holds a sentinel end marker (xListEnd), which has the maximum item value.

Defines a contiguous memory region usable by the FreeRTOS heap (used by heap_5). Each region provides a start address and its size in bytes. An array of these, terminated by an entry with size 0, is passed to vPortDefineHeapRegions().

Holds snapshot statistics about the heap: current total free space, largest/smallest free block sizes, count of free blocks, historical minimum free bytes, and cumulative allocation/free counts. Filled by vPortGetHeapStats().

objects.definition: struct xMEMORY_REGION;
objects.description: Incomplete forward declaration of a port-defined MPU memory region descriptor used with MPU wrapper functionality. Actual structure layout is defined in the port layer, not in this header. Used as input to vPortStoreTaskMPUSettings when MPU wrappers are enabled.

Parameter pack struct for MPU_xTaskGenericNotifyEntry, holding task notification arguments (task handle, notification index, value, action, and optional out pointer for the previous value). Intended to pass arguments across MPU boundary. Ownership of any pointers remains with caller.
Parameter pack struct for MPU_xTaskGenericNotifyWaitEntry, describing a wait on a task notification index with masks to clear on entry/exit, optional out value, and timeout.

Parameter pack struct for MPU_xTimerGenericCommandFromTaskEntry, holding timer command arguments when issuing a timer daemon command from a task context. pxHigherPriorityTaskWoken may be NULL or point to a BaseType_t to report a context switch need.
Parameter pack struct for MPU_xEventGroupWaitBitsEntry, bundling arguments to wait on bits in an event group with flags for clear-on-exit, wait-for-all, and a timeout.

These are macros expanding to GCC function/data attributes that place code or data into special linker sections when MPU wrappers are enabled. They are not types; no custom structs, enums, typedefs, or classes are defined in this header.

A task handle type referenced in this header via casts in vApplicationStackOverflowHook calls. It is not defined in this header; its canonical definition resides elsewhere in the FreeRTOS kernel headers. Details unknown here.

Built-in type pointer referenced as char * pcOverflowTaskName; not a custom type. No custom data types (structs, enums, typedefs, or classes) are defined in this header file. All identifiers are macros and external symbols. Nothing to extract.

objects.definition: typedef void (* TaskFunction_t)( void * arg );
objects.description: Function pointer type for FreeRTOS task entry functions. Points to a function taking a single void* argument and returning void. Used when creating tasks to specify the task routine signature.

objects.definition: typedef portSTACK_TYPE   StackType_t;
objects.description: Alias for the architecture's stack element type. Here portSTACK_TYPE is defined as unsigned long, so StackType_t is unsigned long. Used for task stacks and stack memory buffers.

objects.definition: typedef long             BaseType_t;
objects.description: Signed base integer type used by the FreeRTOS API for return values and counters on this port. Here it resolves to long.

objects.definition: typedef unsigned long    UBaseType_t;
objects.description: Unsigned variant of the base integer type used by the FreeRTOS API for sizes, counts, and bitfields on this port.

objects.definition: typedef unsigned long    TickType_t;
objects.description: FreeRTOS tick count type for this port. Represents time in RTOS ticks. Here it is unsigned long. Note: The header defines portMAX_DELAY as the ULONG_MAX cast to TickType_t.

functions.name: xTaskCreate
functions.signature: BaseType_t xTaskCreate(TaskFunction_t pxTaskCode, const char * const pcName, const configSTACK_DEPTH_TYPE uxStackDepth, void * const pvParameters, UBaseType_t uxPriority, TaskHandle_t * const pxCreatedTask)
functions.description: Creates a new task with dynamically allocated TCB and stack, then adds it to the Ready list. Use for non-MPU or unrestricted tasks. Returns pdPASS on success.
requirements: configSUPPORT_DYNAMIC_ALLOCATION must be 1.
pxTaskCode must be a non-returning task function (infinite loop).
pcName length must be <= configMAX_TASK_NAME_LEN.
uxStackDepth is in stack elements (words), not bytes.
pvParameters must remain valid if the task expects to access it after creation.
If creating privileged task on MPU ports, set uxPriority with portPRIVILEGE_BIT as needed.
pxCreatedTask can be NULL if handle not needed; otherwise must be valid pointer.

functions.name: xTaskCreateAffinitySet
functions.signature: BaseType_t xTaskCreateAffinitySet(TaskFunction_t pxTaskCode, const char * const pcName, const configSTACK_DEPTH_TYPE uxStackDepth, void * const pvParameters, UBaseType_t uxPriority, UBaseType_t uxCoreAffinityMask, TaskHandle_t * const pxCreatedTask)
functions.description: Creates a new task with a specified core affinity mask (SMP/multi-core), using dynamic allocation.
requirements: configSUPPORT_DYNAMIC_ALLOCATION == 1.
configNUMBER_OF_CORES > 1 and configUSE_CORE_AFFINITY == 1.
uxCoreAffinityMask indicates allowed cores by bitmask; bits must refer to cores 0..configNUMBER_OF_CORES-1.
All other xTaskCreate requirements apply.

functions.name: xTaskCreateStatic
functions.signature: TaskHandle_t xTaskCreateStatic(TaskFunction_t pxTaskCode, const char * const pcName, const configSTACK_DEPTH_TYPE uxStackDepth, void * const pvParameters, UBaseType_t uxPriority, StackType_t * const puxStackBuffer, StaticTask_t * const pxTaskBuffer)
functions.description: Creates a new task using application-supplied static buffers for the TCB and stack. Returns the created task handle or NULL on failure.
requirements: configSUPPORT_STATIC_ALLOCATION == 1.
pxTaskCode must be a non-returning task function.
pcName length <= configMAX_TASK_NAME_LEN.
uxStackDepth is in words.
puxStackBuffer must point to an array of at least uxStackDepth StackType_t elements.
pxTaskBuffer must point to a valid StaticTask_t storage.
pvParameters must remain valid if used by the task.

functions.name: xTaskCreateStaticAffinitySet
functions.signature: TaskHandle_t xTaskCreateStaticAffinitySet(TaskFunction_t pxTaskCode, const char * const pcName, const configSTACK_DEPTH_TYPE uxStackDepth, void * const pvParameters, UBaseType_t uxPriority, StackType_t * const puxStackBuffer, StaticTask_t * const pxTaskBuffer, UBaseType_t uxCoreAffinityMask)
functions.description: Creates a new statically allocated task with a specified core affinity mask (SMP/multi-core).
requirements: configSUPPORT_STATIC_ALLOCATION == 1.
configNUMBER_OF_CORES > 1 and configUSE_CORE_AFFINITY == 1.
All xTaskCreateStatic requirements apply.
uxCoreAffinityMask bits select valid cores 0..configNUMBER_OF_CORES-1.

functions.name: xTaskCreateRestricted
functions.signature: BaseType_t xTaskCreateRestricted(const TaskParameters_t * const pxTaskDefinition, TaskHandle_t * pxCreatedTask)
functions.description: Creates an MPU-restricted task using dynamic allocation, with memory regions and permissions defined in TaskParameters_t.
requirements: portUSING_MPU_WRAPPERS == 1 and configSUPPORT_DYNAMIC_ALLOCATION == 1.
pxTaskDefinition must describe task code, name, stack depth (words), priority, optional stack buffer, and xRegions for MPU.
If privileged execution is desired, set portPRIVILEGE_BIT in uxPriority.
pxCreatedTask optional (can be NULL).

functions.name: xTaskCreateRestrictedAffinitySet
functions.signature: BaseType_t xTaskCreateRestrictedAffinitySet(const TaskParameters_t * const pxTaskDefinition, UBaseType_t uxCoreAffinityMask, TaskHandle_t * pxCreatedTask)
functions.description: Creates a dynamically allocated MPU-restricted task with a specified core affinity mask (SMP/multi-core).
requirements: portUSING_MPU_WRAPPERS == 1 and configSUPPORT_DYNAMIC_ALLOCATION == 1.
configNUMBER_OF_CORES > 1 and configUSE_CORE_AFFINITY == 1.
pxTaskDefinition fields and MPU region definitions must be valid.
uxCoreAffinityMask must only include valid core bits.

functions.name: xTaskCreateRestrictedStatic
functions.signature: BaseType_t xTaskCreateRestrictedStatic(const TaskParameters_t * const pxTaskDefinition, TaskHandle_t * pxCreatedTask)
functions.description: Creates an MPU-restricted task using application-supplied static TCB/stack buffers (provided via TaskParameters_t when static allocation is enabled).
requirements: portUSING_MPU_WRAPPERS == 1 and configSUPPORT_STATIC_ALLOCATION == 1.
pxTaskDefinition must include pointers to stack buffer and StaticTask_t if required.
MPU region parameters (xRegions) must be valid.
pxCreatedTask optional.

functions.name: xTaskCreateRestrictedStaticAffinitySet
functions.signature: BaseType_t xTaskCreateRestrictedStaticAffinitySet(const TaskParameters_t * const pxTaskDefinition, UBaseType_t uxCoreAffinityMask, TaskHandle_t * pxCreatedTask)
functions.description: Creates a statically allocated MPU-restricted task with a specified core affinity mask (SMP/multi-core).
requirements: portUSING_MPU_WRAPPERS == 1 and configSUPPORT_STATIC_ALLOCATION == 1.
configNUMBER_OF_CORES > 1 and configUSE_CORE_AFFINITY == 1.
pxTaskDefinition must provide valid static storage and MPU regions.
uxCoreAffinityMask must only include valid core bits.

functions.name: vTaskAllocateMPURegions
functions.signature: void vTaskAllocateMPURegions(TaskHandle_t xTaskToModify, const MemoryRegion_t * const pxRegions)
functions.description: Reassigns MPU memory regions for a restricted task. Pass NULL as xTaskToModify to update the calling task.
requirements: portUSING_MPU_WRAPPERS == 1.
pxRegions must point to an array of portNUM_CONFIGURABLE_REGIONS entries defining base, length, and parameters.
xTaskToModify can be NULL (affects calling task) or a valid task handle.

functions.name: vTaskDelete
functions.signature: void vTaskDelete(TaskHandle_t xTaskToDelete)
functions.description: Deletes a task and removes it from all kernel lists. Idle task later frees kernel-allocated memory.
requirements: INCLUDE_vTaskDelete must be enabled (implicitly in this header).
xTaskToDelete can be NULL to delete the calling task, otherwise must be a valid handle.
Any application-allocated resources must be freed by the task before deletion to avoid leaks.
Ensure idle task gets CPU time to clean up deleted tasks.

functions.name: vTaskDelay
functions.signature: void vTaskDelay(const TickType_t xTicksToDelay)
functions.description: Blocks the calling task for a relative number of ticks (delay). Use for simple delays; use xTaskDelayUntil for periodic execution.
requirements: INCLUDE_vTaskDelay must be 1.
xTicksToDelay is in ticks; use pdMS_TO_TICKS for ms conversion.
Must not be called in ISR context.
Scheduler must be running.

functions.name: xTaskDelayUntil
functions.signature: BaseType_t xTaskDelayUntil(TickType_t * const pxPreviousWakeTime, const TickType_t xTimeIncrement)
functions.description: Delays task until an absolute tick time to facilitate fixed-rate periodic execution; updates pxPreviousWakeTime internally.
requirements: INCLUDE_xTaskDelayUntil must be 1.
pxPreviousWakeTime must be initialized with xTaskGetTickCount() before first call and must be a valid pointer.
xTimeIncrement is the period in ticks (>0 recommended).
Not callable from ISR.

functions.name: xTaskAbortDelay
functions.signature: BaseType_t xTaskAbortDelay(TaskHandle_t xTask)
functions.description: If the task is blocked (delay or object wait), forces it to leave the Blocked state and return from the blocking call.
requirements: INCLUDE_xTaskAbortDelay == 1.
xTask must be a valid task handle; there is no FromISR variant.
Returns pdPASS if the task was blocked and was aborted; pdFAIL otherwise.

functions.name: uxTaskPriorityGet
functions.signature: UBaseType_t uxTaskPriorityGet(const TaskHandle_t xTask)
functions.description: Returns the current priority of the specified task, or the calling task if xTask is NULL.
requirements: INCLUDE_uxTaskPriorityGet == 1.
xTask may be NULL to query the calling task.
Callable from task context.

functions.name: uxTaskPriorityGetFromISR
functions.signature: UBaseType_t uxTaskPriorityGetFromISR(const TaskHandle_t xTask)
functions.description: ISR-safe version of uxTaskPriorityGet.
requirements: xTask must be a valid handle or NULL to refer to the running task (as supported by the port).
Callable from ISR context.

functions.name: uxTaskBasePriorityGet
functions.signature: UBaseType_t uxTaskBasePriorityGet(const TaskHandle_t xTask)
functions.description: Returns the base (non-inherited) priority of a task, or the calling task if xTask is NULL.
requirements: INCLUDE_uxTaskPriorityGet == 1 and configUSE_MUTEXES == 1.
xTask may be NULL to query the calling task.

functions.name: uxTaskBasePriorityGetFromISR
functions.signature: UBaseType_t uxTaskBasePriorityGetFromISR(const TaskHandle_t xTask)
functions.description: ISR-safe version of uxTaskBasePriorityGet.
requirements: configUSE_MUTEXES == 1.
xTask must be valid or NULL as supported by the port.

functions.name: eTaskGetState
functions.signature: eTaskState eTaskGetState(TaskHandle_t xTask)
functions.description: Returns the current scheduler state of the given task at the time of the call.
requirements: INCLUDE_eTaskGetState == 1 or configUSE_TRACE_FACILITY == 1 or INCLUDE_xTaskAbortDelay == 1.
xTask must be a valid handle.
State may change immediately after return.

functions.name: vTaskGetInfo
functions.signature: void vTaskGetInfo(TaskHandle_t xTask, TaskStatus_t * pxTaskStatus, BaseType_t xGetFreeStackSpace, eTaskState eState)
functions.description: Populates TaskStatus_t with details about a task; optionally includes stack high-water mark and state.
requirements: configUSE_TRACE_FACILITY == 1.
xTask can be NULL to refer to the calling task; otherwise must be valid.
pxTaskStatus must be a valid pointer.
xGetFreeStackSpace != pdFALSE to compute stack high-water mark (can be time-consuming).
If eState == eInvalid, the function fetches actual state; otherwise the given eState value is simply reported.

functions.name: vTaskPrioritySet
functions.signature: void vTaskPrioritySet(TaskHandle_t xTask, UBaseType_t uxNewPriority)
functions.description: Sets a task's priority; may trigger an immediate context switch if raised above the running task.
requirements: INCLUDE_vTaskPrioritySet == 1.
xTask may be NULL to set the calling task's priority.
uxNewPriority must be within the configured priority range for the port.
Not callable from ISR.

functions.name: vTaskSuspend
functions.signature: void vTaskSuspend(TaskHandle_t xTaskToSuspend)
functions.description: Suspends a task, preventing it from running until resumed.
requirements: INCLUDE_vTaskSuspend == 1.
xTaskToSuspend may be NULL to suspend the calling task.
Calls are not cumulative; a single vTaskResume will resume.

functions.name: vTaskResume
functions.signature: void vTaskResume(TaskHandle_t xTaskToResume)
functions.description: Resumes a previously suspended task.
requirements: INCLUDE_vTaskSuspend == 1.
xTaskToResume must be a valid suspended task handle.
Not callable from ISR; use xTaskResumeFromISR instead.

functions.name: xTaskResumeFromISR
functions.signature: BaseType_t xTaskResumeFromISR(TaskHandle_t xTaskToResume)
functions.description: ISR-capable version to resume a suspended task; indicates if a context switch should occur.
requirements: INCLUDE_xTaskResumeFromISR == 1.
xTaskToResume must refer to a suspended task.
Returns pdTRUE if a context switch should be requested from the ISR.

functions.name: vTaskCoreAffinitySet
functions.signature: void vTaskCoreAffinitySet(const TaskHandle_t xTask, UBaseType_t uxCoreAffinityMask)
functions.description: Sets the allowed core affinity mask for a task (SMP/multi-core).
requirements: configUSE_CORE_AFFINITY == 1.
xTask may be NULL to affect the calling task.
uxCoreAffinityMask bits indicate cores 0..configNUMBER_OF_CORES-1; at least one valid bit should be set.

functions.name: vTaskCoreAffinityGet
functions.signature: UBaseType_t vTaskCoreAffinityGet(ConstTaskHandle_t xTask)
functions.description: Retrieves a task's core affinity mask (SMP/multi-core).
requirements: configNUMBER_OF_CORES > 1 and configUSE_CORE_AFFINITY == 1.
xTask may be NULL to query the calling task.

functions.name: vTaskPreemptionDisable
functions.signature: void vTaskPreemptionDisable(const TaskHandle_t xTask)
functions.description: Disables preemption for the specified task (or calling task if NULL), preventing it from being preempted while running.
requirements: configUSE_TASK_PREEMPTION_DISABLE == 1.
xTask may be NULL to act on the calling task.

functions.name: vTaskPreemptionEnable
functions.signature: void vTaskPreemptionEnable(const TaskHandle_t xTask)
functions.description: Enables preemption for the specified task (or calling task if NULL).
requirements: configUSE_TASK_PREEMPTION_DISABLE == 1.
xTask may be NULL to act on the calling task.

functions.name: vTaskStartScheduler
functions.signature: void vTaskStartScheduler(void)
functions.description: Starts the scheduler and begins executing tasks; does not return unless the scheduler ends or fails to start.
requirements: At least one task should be created before calling.
Must not be called from ISR.
If the scheduler fails to start (e.g., insufficient memory for idle/timer tasks), function may return.

functions.name: vTaskEndScheduler
functions.signature: void vTaskEndScheduler(void)
functions.description: Stops the scheduler and deletes all tasks; returns to the point where vTaskStartScheduler was called. Only implemented on select ports (e.g., x86 real mode).
requirements: Port must implement vPortEndScheduler; not available on most MCU ports.
Must not be called from ISR.
Application must manage its own resources; only kernel resources are freed.

functions.name: vTaskSuspendAll
functions.signature: void vTaskSuspendAll(void)
functions.description: Suspends the scheduler without disabling interrupts; prevents context switches until xTaskResumeAll is called.
requirements: Do not call APIs that may cause a context switch while the scheduler is suspended (e.g., xTaskDelayUntil, xQueueSend).
Use xTaskResumeAll to resume scheduling.
Callable from task context.

functions.name: xTaskResumeAll
functions.signature: BaseType_t xTaskResumeAll(void)
functions.description: Resumes scheduler activity after vTaskSuspendAll; may perform a context switch.
requirements: Must be called once for each vTaskSuspendAll to resume scheduling.
Returns pdTRUE if a context switch occurred as a result of resuming.

functions.name: xTaskGetTickCount
functions.signature: TickType_t xTaskGetTickCount(void)
functions.description: Returns the number of ticks since the scheduler started.
requirements: Callable from task context.
Scheduler should be started for meaningful values.

functions.name: xTaskGetTickCountFromISR
functions.signature: TickType_t xTaskGetTickCountFromISR(void)
functions.description: ISR-safe version of xTaskGetTickCount; safe if TickType_t is natural word size or interrupts nesting is not used.
requirements: Callable from ISR context.

functions.name: uxTaskGetNumberOfTasks
functions.signature: UBaseType_t uxTaskGetNumberOfTasks(void)
functions.description: Returns the number of tasks currently under kernel control (includes ready, blocked, suspended, and tasks pending deletion).
requirements: Callable from task context.

functions.name: pcTaskGetName
functions.signature: char * pcTaskGetName(TaskHandle_t xTaskToQuery)
functions.description: Returns the human-readable name of a task. Pass NULL to get the calling task's name.
requirements: xTaskToQuery may be NULL or a valid task handle.
Returned pointer may become invalid if the task is deleted.

functions.name: xTaskGetHandle
functions.signature: TaskHandle_t xTaskGetHandle(const char * pcNameToQuery)
functions.description: Finds a task by its name string and returns its handle; returns NULL if not found. Slow; use sparingly.
requirements: INCLUDE_xTaskGetHandle == 1.
pcNameToQuery must be a valid, null-terminated string.

functions.name: xTaskGetStaticBuffers
functions.signature: BaseType_t xTaskGetStaticBuffers(TaskHandle_t xTask, StackType_t ** ppuxStackBuffer, StaticTask_t ** ppxTaskBuffer)
functions.description: Retrieves the static stack buffer and TCB storage pointers of a statically created task.
requirements: configSUPPORT_STATIC_ALLOCATION == 1.
xTask must refer to a statically created task.
ppuxStackBuffer and ppxTaskBuffer must be valid pointers to receive outputs.
Returns pdTRUE on success, pdFALSE otherwise.

functions.name: uxTaskGetStackHighWaterMark
functions.signature: UBaseType_t uxTaskGetStackHighWaterMark(TaskHandle_t xTask)
functions.description: Returns the minimum ever remaining stack space (in words) for the specified task (high-water mark).
requirements: INCLUDE_uxTaskGetStackHighWaterMark == 1.
xTask may be NULL to query the calling task.
Computing value may be time-consuming on some ports.

functions.name: uxTaskGetStackHighWaterMark2
functions.signature: configSTACK_DEPTH_TYPE uxTaskGetStackHighWaterMark2(TaskHandle_t xTask)
functions.description: Like uxTaskGetStackHighWaterMark but returns configSTACK_DEPTH_TYPE to avoid overflow on small types.
requirements: INCLUDE_uxTaskGetStackHighWaterMark2 == 1.
xTask may be NULL to query the calling task.

functions.name: vTaskSetApplicationTaskTag
functions.signature: void vTaskSetApplicationTaskTag(TaskHandle_t xTask, TaskHookFunction_t pxHookFunction)
functions.description: Associates an application-defined hook function with a task; NULL xTask sets the calling task's hook.
requirements: configUSE_APPLICATION_TASK_TAG == 1.
xTask may be NULL to affect the calling task.
pxHookFunction can be NULL to clear the tag.

functions.name: xTaskGetApplicationTaskTag
functions.signature: TaskHookFunction_t xTaskGetApplicationTaskTag(TaskHandle_t xTask)
functions.description: Returns the hook function associated with the specified task. Not ISR-safe.
requirements: configUSE_APPLICATION_TASK_TAG == 1.
xTask must be a valid task handle or NULL to query the calling task.
Call xTaskGetApplicationTaskTagFromISR from ISR instead.

functions.name: xTaskGetApplicationTaskTagFromISR
functions.signature: TaskHookFunction_t xTaskGetApplicationTaskTagFromISR(TaskHandle_t xTask)
functions.description: ISR-safe version of xTaskGetApplicationTaskTag.
requirements: configUSE_APPLICATION_TASK_TAG == 1.
xTask must be a valid task handle or NULL to query current running task as supported.

functions.name: vTaskSetThreadLocalStoragePointer
functions.signature: void vTaskSetThreadLocalStoragePointer(TaskHandle_t xTaskToSet, BaseType_t xIndex, void * pvValue)
functions.description: Sets a thread-local storage pointer at a given index for a task.
requirements: configNUM_THREAD_LOCAL_STORAGE_POINTERS > 0.
xTaskToSet must be a valid task handle.
xIndex must be in range [0, configNUM_THREAD_LOCAL_STORAGE_POINTERS-1].

functions.name: pvTaskGetThreadLocalStoragePointer
functions.signature: void * pvTaskGetThreadLocalStoragePointer(TaskHandle_t xTaskToQuery, BaseType_t xIndex)
functions.description: Gets a thread-local storage pointer at a given index for a task.
requirements: configNUM_THREAD_LOCAL_STORAGE_POINTERS > 0.
xTaskToQuery must be a valid task handle.
xIndex must be in range [0, configNUM_THREAD_LOCAL_STORAGE_POINTERS-1].

functions.name: vApplicationStackOverflowHook
functions.signature: void vApplicationStackOverflowHook(TaskHandle_t xTask, char * pcTaskName)
functions.description: Application-provided hook called when a task stack overflow is detected.
requirements: configCHECK_FOR_STACK_OVERFLOW > 0.
Application must implement this function when enabled.
Must not block inside the hook.

functions.name: vApplicationIdleHook
functions.signature: void vApplicationIdleHook(void)
functions.description: Application idle hook called by the idle task to perform background work.
requirements: configUSE_IDLE_HOOK == 1.
Must NEVER call any function that can block.

functions.name: vApplicationTickHook
functions.signature: void vApplicationTickHook(void)
functions.description: Application hook called from the system tick interrupt after OS work is completed.
requirements: configUSE_TICK_HOOK != 0.
Must be ISR-safe; must be short and non-blocking.

functions.name: vApplicationGetIdleTaskMemory
functions.signature: void vApplicationGetIdleTaskMemory(StaticTask_t ** ppxIdleTaskTCBBuffer, StackType_t ** ppxIdleTaskStackBuffer, configSTACK_DEPTH_TYPE * puxIdleTaskStackSize)
functions.description: Supplies static memory buffers for the idle task TCB and stack when using static allocation.
requirements: configSUPPORT_STATIC_ALLOCATION == 1.
Application must implement and provide valid pointers to TCB buffer, stack buffer, and stack size (in words).

functions.name: vApplicationGetPassiveIdleTaskMemory
functions.signature: void vApplicationGetPassiveIdleTaskMemory(StaticTask_t ** ppxIdleTaskTCBBuffer, StackType_t ** ppxIdleTaskStackBuffer, configSTACK_DEPTH_TYPE * puxIdleTaskStackSize, BaseType_t xPassiveIdleTaskIndex)
functions.description: Supplies static memory buffers for passive idle tasks on SMP systems.
requirements: configSUPPORT_STATIC_ALLOCATION == 1 and configNUMBER_OF_CORES > 1.
xPassiveIdleTaskIndex in [0, configNUMBER_OF_CORES - 2].
Provide valid TCB buffer, stack buffer, and stack size (words).

functions.name: xTaskCallApplicationTaskHook
functions.signature: BaseType_t xTaskCallApplicationTaskHook(TaskHandle_t xTask, void * pvParameter)
functions.description: Calls the task's registered application hook with pvParameter; NULL xTask calls the calling task's hook. Returns the hook's return value.
requirements: configUSE_APPLICATION_TASK_TAG == 1.
Hook function must be previously set for the target task, or NULL is allowed per app semantics.

functions.name: xTaskGetIdleTaskHandle
functions.signature: TaskHandle_t xTaskGetIdleTaskHandle(void)
functions.description: Returns the idle task handle (single-core: the only idle task; SMP: use xTaskGetIdleTaskHandleForCore). Not valid before scheduler start.
requirements: INCLUDE_xTaskGetIdleTaskHandle == 1 and configNUMBER_OF_CORES == 1.
Call only after scheduler is started.

functions.name: xTaskGetIdleTaskHandleForCore
functions.signature: TaskHandle_t xTaskGetIdleTaskHandleForCore(BaseType_t xCoreID)
functions.description: Returns the idle task handle for the given core (0 is the active idle task, others are passive).
requirements: INCLUDE_xTaskGetIdleTaskHandle == 1.
xCoreID must be a valid core index 0..configNUMBER_OF_CORES-1.
Call only after scheduler is started.

functions.name: uxTaskGetSystemState
functions.signature: UBaseType_t uxTaskGetSystemState(TaskStatus_t * const pxTaskStatusArray, const UBaseType_t uxArraySize, configRUN_TIME_COUNTER_TYPE * const pulTotalRunTime)
functions.description: Snapshots the system task list into an array of TaskStatus_t, optionally returning total run time. Intended for debugging; suspends scheduler during snapshot.
requirements: configUSE_TRACE_FACILITY == 1.
pxTaskStatusArray must point to an array with at least one element per task (see uxTaskGetNumberOfTasks).
uxArraySize must be the number of elements in pxTaskStatusArray.
pulTotalRunTime can be NULL to skip total run time; otherwise must be valid.
May take time; avoid in time-critical paths.

functions.name: vTaskListTasks
functions.signature: void vTaskListTasks(char * pcWriteBuffer, size_t uxBufferLength)
functions.description: Formats and writes a human-readable table of task states into pcWriteBuffer using data from uxTaskGetSystemState.
requirements: configUSE_TRACE_FACILITY == 1 and configUSE_STATS_FORMATTING_FUNCTIONS > 0.
pcWriteBuffer must be a writable buffer large enough; approx. 40 bytes per task.
uxBufferLength must be the buffer size in bytes.
Disables interrupts during execution; for debugging only.

functions.name: vTaskGetRunTimeStatistics
functions.signature: void vTaskGetRunTimeStatistics(char * pcWriteBuffer, size_t uxBufferLength)
functions.description: Formats and writes a table of per-task run-time statistics into pcWriteBuffer.
requirements: configGENERATE_RUN_TIME_STATS == 1, configUSE_STATS_FORMATTING_FUNCTIONS > 0, and configUSE_TRACE_FACILITY == 1.
portCONFIGURE_TIMER_FOR_RUN_TIME_STATS and portGET_RUN_TIME_COUNTER_VALUE must be provided by the application.
pcWriteBuffer must be large enough; approx. 40 bytes per task.
Disables interrupts during execution; for debugging only.

functions.name: ulTaskGetRunTimeCounter
functions.signature: configRUN_TIME_COUNTER_TYPE ulTaskGetRunTimeCounter(const TaskHandle_t xTask)
functions.description: Returns the total run time counter value accumulated by the specified task since boot.
requirements: configGENERATE_RUN_TIME_STATS == 1.
xTask must be a valid task handle.
Application must provide run-time stats timer macros.

functions.name: ulTaskGetRunTimePercent
functions.signature: configRUN_TIME_COUNTER_TYPE ulTaskGetRunTimePercent(const TaskHandle_t xTask)
functions.description: Returns the percentage of total CPU time used by the specified task since boot.
requirements: configGENERATE_RUN_TIME_STATS == 1.
xTask must be valid.
Requires configured run-time stats timer macros.

functions.name: ulTaskGetIdleRunTimeCounter
functions.signature: configRUN_TIME_COUNTER_TYPE ulTaskGetIdleRunTimeCounter(void)
functions.description: Returns the total run time accumulated by the idle task.
requirements: configGENERATE_RUN_TIME_STATS == 1 and INCLUDE_xTaskGetIdleTaskHandle == 1.
Run-time stats timer must be configured.

functions.name: ulTaskGetIdleRunTimePercent
functions.signature: configRUN_TIME_COUNTER_TYPE ulTaskGetIdleRunTimePercent(void)
functions.description: Returns the percentage of CPU time consumed by the idle task.
requirements: configGENERATE_RUN_TIME_STATS == 1 and INCLUDE_xTaskGetIdleTaskHandle == 1.
Run-time stats timer must be configured.

functions.name: xTaskGenericNotify
functions.signature: BaseType_t xTaskGenericNotify(TaskHandle_t xTaskToNotify, UBaseType_t uxIndexToNotify, uint32_t ulValue, eNotifyAction eAction, uint32_t * pulPreviousNotificationValue)
functions.description: Sends a direct-to-task notification to the given task at the specified notification index, optionally modifying and/or returning the previous notify value.
requirements: configUSE_TASK_NOTIFICATIONS must be enabled (default 1).
xTaskToNotify must be a valid task handle.
uxIndexToNotify must be < configTASK_NOTIFICATION_ARRAY_ENTRIES.
eAction selects how the notification value is updated; see eNotifyAction.
pulPreviousNotificationValue may be NULL or a valid pointer to receive prior value.

functions.name: xTaskGenericNotifyFromISR
functions.signature: BaseType_t xTaskGenericNotifyFromISR(TaskHandle_t xTaskToNotify, UBaseType_t uxIndexToNotify, uint32_t ulValue, eNotifyAction eAction, uint32_t * pulPreviousNotificationValue, BaseType_t * pxHigherPriorityTaskWoken)
functions.description: ISR-capable version of xTaskGenericNotify; may request a context switch via pxHigherPriorityTaskWoken.
requirements: configUSE_TASK_NOTIFICATIONS must be enabled.
xTaskToNotify valid; uxIndexToNotify < configTASK_NOTIFICATION_ARRAY_ENTRIES.
pxHigherPriorityTaskWoken must be a valid pointer.
ISR-safe constraints apply; keep handler short.

functions.name: xTaskGenericNotifyWait
functions.signature: BaseType_t xTaskGenericNotifyWait(UBaseType_t uxIndexToWaitOn, uint32_t ulBitsToClearOnEntry, uint32_t ulBitsToClearOnExit, uint32_t * pulNotificationValue, TickType_t xTicksToWait)
functions.description: Blocks the calling task waiting for a pending notification on the specified index, with bit-masking on entry/exit and optional retrieval of the notification value.
requirements: configUSE_TASK_NOTIFICATIONS must be enabled.
uxIndexToWaitOn < configTASK_NOTIFICATION_ARRAY_ENTRIES.
pulNotificationValue may be NULL or valid to receive the value.
xTicksToWait is in ticks; use pdMS_TO_TICKS for conversion.
Not callable from ISR.

functions.name: vTaskGenericNotifyGiveFromISR
functions.signature: void vTaskGenericNotifyGiveFromISR(TaskHandle_t xTaskToNotify, UBaseType_t uxIndexToNotify, BaseType_t * pxHigherPriorityTaskWoken)
functions.description: ISR API to 'give' a notification (increment semantics) to a task at the specified index; may request a context switch.
requirements: configUSE_TASK_NOTIFICATIONS must be enabled.
xTaskToNotify valid; uxIndexToNotify < configTASK_NOTIFICATION_ARRAY_ENTRIES.
pxHigherPriorityTaskWoken must be a valid pointer.

functions.name: ulTaskGenericNotifyTake
functions.signature: uint32_t ulTaskGenericNotifyTake(UBaseType_t uxIndexToWaitOn, BaseType_t xClearCountOnExit, TickType_t xTicksToWait)
functions.description: Blocks to wait until the notification value at the index is non-zero, then either clears to zero or decrements it; returns the value before modification.
requirements: configUSE_TASK_NOTIFICATIONS must be enabled.
uxIndexToWaitOn < configTASK_NOTIFICATION_ARRAY_ENTRIES.
xClearCountOnExit == pdFALSE to decrement (counting semaphore) or non-false to clear (binary).
xTicksToWait in ticks. Not ISR-safe.

functions.name: xTaskGenericNotifyStateClear
functions.signature: BaseType_t xTaskGenericNotifyStateClear(TaskHandle_t xTask, UBaseType_t uxIndexToClear)
functions.description: Clears the pending state (not the value) of a task notification at the given index for the specified or calling task.
requirements: configUSE_TASK_NOTIFICATIONS must be enabled.
xTask may be NULL to clear the calling task; otherwise must be valid.
uxIndexToClear < configTASK_NOTIFICATION_ARRAY_ENTRIES.
Returns pdTRUE if state was set and got cleared.

functions.name: ulTaskGenericNotifyValueClear
functions.signature: uint32_t ulTaskGenericNotifyValueClear(TaskHandle_t xTask, UBaseType_t uxIndexToClear, uint32_t ulBitsToClear)
functions.description: Clears specified bits in a task's notification value at the given index; returns the value prior to clearing.
requirements: configUSE_TASK_NOTIFICATIONS must be enabled.
xTask may be NULL to act on the calling task; else must be valid.
uxIndexToClear < configTASK_NOTIFICATION_ARRAY_ENTRIES.
ulBitsToClear bitmask: set bits to clear; 0xFFFFFFFF clears all bits to 0; 0 queries without clearing when 0.

functions.name: vTaskSetTimeOutState
functions.signature: void vTaskSetTimeOutState(TimeOut_t * const pxTimeOut)
functions.description: Captures the current tick count and overflow count into a TimeOut_t for later timeout calculations.
requirements: pxTimeOut must be a valid pointer.
Use with xTaskCheckForTimeOut to manage relative timeouts across blocking calls.

functions.name: xTaskCheckForTimeOut
functions.signature: BaseType_t xTaskCheckForTimeOut(TimeOut_t * const pxTimeOut, TickType_t * const pxTicksToWait)
functions.description: Determines if a timeout has occurred based on a previously captured TimeOut_t and a remaining ticks-to-wait value. Updates both structures.
requirements: pxTimeOut must have been initialized via vTaskSetTimeOutState or xTaskCheckForTimeOut.
pxTicksToWait must be a valid pointer with remaining ticks; updated on return.
Returns pdTRUE if timeout occurred; pdFALSE and updates pxTicksToWait otherwise.

functions.name: xTaskCatchUpTicks
functions.signature: BaseType_t xTaskCatchUpTicks(TickType_t xTicksToCatchUp)
functions.description: Moves the tick count forward by the specified number of ticks to catch up after extended interrupt disable periods; may trigger unblocks and a context switch.
requirements: xTicksToCatchUp must be the number of missed ticks computed by the application.
Callable from task context; port-specific constraints may apply.
Returns pdTRUE if a context switch occurred.

functions.name: vTaskResetState
functions.signature: void vTaskResetState(void)
functions.description: Resets internal task state; must be called by the application before restarting the scheduler.
requirements: Call before restarting the scheduler after it was stopped.
Use only when required by the application’s restart sequence.

functions.name: xTaskIncrementTick
functions.signature: BaseType_t xTaskIncrementTick(void)
functions.description: Kernel internal: tick ISR hook that increments the tick count and manages timeouts/time slicing. Returns non-zero if a context switch is required.
requirements: Scheduler/port internal use only; do not call from application code.
Called from the tick ISR.

functions.name: vTaskPlaceOnEventList
functions.signature: void vTaskPlaceOnEventList(List_t * const pxEventList, const TickType_t xTicksToWait)
functions.description: Kernel internal: places the calling task on an ordered event list (by priority) and on the delayed list to block for up to xTicksToWait.
requirements: Interrupts must be disabled when calling (internal use).
pxEventList must be a valid list.
Application code must not call this directly.

functions.name: vTaskPlaceOnUnorderedEventList
functions.signature: void vTaskPlaceOnUnorderedEventList(List_t * pxEventList, const TickType_t xItemValue, const TickType_t xTicksToWait)
functions.description: Kernel internal: places the calling task on an unordered event list with item value xItemValue, and on the delayed list.
requirements: Interrupts must be disabled when calling (internal use).
pxEventList must be valid.
Application code must not call directly.

functions.name: vTaskPlaceOnEventListRestricted
functions.signature: void vTaskPlaceOnEventListRestricted(List_t * const pxEventList, TickType_t xTicksToWait, const BaseType_t xWaitIndefinitely)
functions.description: Kernel internal: like vTaskPlaceOnEventList, but does not permit indefinite block when xWaitIndefinitely is false.
requirements: Interrupts must be disabled when calling (internal use).
pxEventList valid. Do not call from application code.

functions.name: xTaskRemoveFromEventList
functions.signature: BaseType_t xTaskRemoveFromEventList(const List_t * const pxEventList)
functions.description: Kernel internal: removes the highest-priority task from an ordered event list and readies it; returns pdTRUE if preemption to that task is needed.
requirements: Internal use; not for application code.
pxEventList must be a valid event list.
Called with appropriate scheduler/interrupt state.

functions.name: vTaskRemoveFromUnorderedEventList
functions.signature: void vTaskRemoveFromUnorderedEventList(ListItem_t * pxEventListItem, const TickType_t xItemValue)
functions.description: Kernel internal: removes a task from an unordered event list and updates its list item value to xItemValue before readying.
requirements: Internal use only; interrupts disabled when calling.
pxEventListItem must be valid.

functions.name: vTaskSwitchContext
functions.signature: void vTaskSwitchContext(void)
functions.description: Kernel internal (single-core): selects the highest priority ready task as the current task.
requirements: configNUMBER_OF_CORES == 1 for this signature.
Internal use only; do not call from application code.

functions.name: uxTaskResetEventItemValue
functions.signature: TickType_t uxTaskResetEventItemValue(void)
functions.description: Kernel internal: returns and resets the calling task’s event list item value.
requirements: Internal use by event bits/queue modules.
Not for application code.

functions.name: xTaskGetCurrentTaskHandle
functions.signature: TaskHandle_t xTaskGetCurrentTaskHandle(void)
functions.description: Returns the handle of the calling (running) task.
requirements: Callable from task context.
Not generally valid from ISR unless port supports it.

functions.name: xTaskGetCurrentTaskHandleForCore
functions.signature: TaskHandle_t xTaskGetCurrentTaskHandleForCore(BaseType_t xCoreID)
functions.description: Returns the handle of the task running on the specified core (SMP).
requirements: xCoreID must be valid (0..configNUMBER_OF_CORES-1).

functions.name: vTaskMissedYield
functions.signature: void vTaskMissedYield(void)
functions.description: Kernel internal: indicates that a yield was missed and should be performed when possible.
requirements: Internal use; called by queue implementation to avoid unnecessary taskYIELD calls.

functions.name: xTaskGetSchedulerState
functions.signature: BaseType_t xTaskGetSchedulerState(void)
functions.description: Returns the scheduler state: taskSCHEDULER_RUNNING, taskSCHEDULER_NOT_STARTED, or taskSCHEDULER_SUSPENDED.
requirements: Callable anytime; result used for assertions or logic.

functions.name: xTaskPriorityInherit
functions.signature: BaseType_t xTaskPriorityInherit(TaskHandle_t const pxMutexHolder)
functions.description: Kernel internal: raises the mutex holder’s priority to that of the calling task if lower, to avoid priority inversion.
requirements: Internal use by mutex implementation; not for direct application use.
pxMutexHolder must be the task currently holding the mutex.

functions.name: xTaskPriorityDisinherit
functions.signature: BaseType_t xTaskPriorityDisinherit(TaskHandle_t const pxMutexHolder)
functions.description: Kernel internal: restores a task’s priority after priority inheritance when releasing a mutex.
requirements: Internal use by mutex implementation.
pxMutexHolder must be valid and have inherited priority context.

functions.name: vTaskPriorityDisinheritAfterTimeout
functions.signature: void vTaskPriorityDisinheritAfterTimeout(TaskHandle_t const pxMutexHolder, UBaseType_t uxHighestPriorityWaitingTask)
functions.description: Kernel internal: adjusts a mutex holder’s inherited priority after a higher-priority waiting task timed out.
requirements: Internal use by mutex/queue implementation.
pxMutexHolder valid; uxHighestPriorityWaitingTask indicates remaining highest waiter.

functions.name: uxTaskGetTaskNumber
functions.signature: UBaseType_t uxTaskGetTaskNumber(TaskHandle_t xTask)
functions.description: Returns a TCB-specific unique identifier automatically assigned on task creation (not the application task number).
requirements: configUSE_TRACE_FACILITY == 1.
xTask must be valid.

functions.name: vTaskSetTaskNumber
functions.signature: void vTaskSetTaskNumber(TaskHandle_t xTask, const UBaseType_t uxHandle)
functions.description: Sets an application-visible task number (separate from the internal unique ID) for the given task.
requirements: configUSE_TRACE_FACILITY == 1.
xTask must be valid.

functions.name: vTaskStepTick
functions.signature: void vTaskStepTick(TickType_t xTicksToJump)
functions.description: In tickless idle, advances the tick count by xTicksToJump to account for time spent sleeping.
requirements: configUSE_TICKLESS_IDLE != 0.
Internal/port use; ensure atomicity and correct call site (usually within tickless implementation).

functions.name: eTaskConfirmSleepModeStatus
functions.signature: eSleepModeStatus eTaskConfirmSleepModeStatus(void)
functions.description: In tickless idle, confirms if it is safe to enter sleep and whether sleep can be indefinite, based on pending operations.
requirements: configUSE_TICKLESS_IDLE != 0.
Call from a short critical section between timer stop and entering low-power mode.

functions.name: pvTaskIncrementMutexHeldCount
functions.signature: TaskHandle_t pvTaskIncrementMutexHeldCount(void)
functions.description: Internal: increments the current task’s count of held mutexes and returns the task handle.
requirements: Internal to mutex implementation.
Not for application use.

functions.name: vTaskInternalSetTimeOutState
functions.signature: void vTaskInternalSetTimeOutState(TimeOut_t * const pxTimeOut)
functions.description: Internal version of vTaskSetTimeOutState without entering a critical section.
requirements: Internal use only; pxTimeOut must be valid.

functions.name: vTaskYieldWithinAPI
functions.signature: void vTaskYieldWithinAPI(void)
functions.description: SMP internal: yields within an API to allow other cores to run higher priority tasks (multi-core only).
requirements: configNUMBER_OF_CORES > 1.
Internal use only.

functions.name: vTaskEnterCritical
functions.signature: void vTaskEnterCritical(void)
functions.description: Internal: updates TCB-maintained critical nesting count; used by ports to implement ENTER_CRITICAL when nesting is in TCB or SMP.
requirements: (portCRITICAL_NESTING_IN_TCB == 1) or (configNUMBER_OF_CORES > 1).
Internal/port use only.

functions.name: vTaskExitCritical
functions.signature: void vTaskExitCritical(void)
functions.description: Internal: counterpart to vTaskEnterCritical; decrements TCB-maintained critical nesting and exits when zero.
requirements: (portCRITICAL_NESTING_IN_TCB == 1) or (configNUMBER_OF_CORES > 1).
Internal/port use only.

functions.name: vTaskEnterCriticalFromISR
functions.signature: UBaseType_t vTaskEnterCriticalFromISR(void)
functions.description: SMP internal: ISR variant to enter critical section, returning saved interrupt status for later restore.
requirements: configNUMBER_OF_CORES > 1.
Internal/port use only. Return value must be passed to vTaskExitCriticalFromISR.

functions.name: vTaskExitCriticalFromISR
functions.signature: void vTaskExitCriticalFromISR(UBaseType_t uxSavedInterruptStatus)
functions.description: SMP internal: exits critical section from ISR and restores interrupt status saved by vTaskEnterCriticalFromISR.
requirements: configNUMBER_OF_CORES > 1.
uxSavedInterruptStatus must be the value returned by vTaskEnterCriticalFromISR in the same critical section.

functions.name: xTaskGetMPUSettings
functions.signature: xMPU_SETTINGS * xTaskGetMPUSettings(TaskHandle_t xTask)
functions.description: Internal (MPU): returns a pointer to the MPU settings associated with a task.
requirements: portUSING_MPU_WRAPPERS == 1.
xTask must be valid.
Internal/port use only.

functions.name: vGrantAccessToKernelObject
functions.signature: void vGrantAccessToKernelObject(TaskHandle_t xExternalTaskHandle, int32_t lExternalKernelObjectHandle)
functions.description: Internal (MPU ACL v2): grants a task access to a kernel object by external handle.
requirements: portUSING_MPU_WRAPPERS == 1, configUSE_MPU_WRAPPERS_V1 == 0, configENABLE_ACCESS_CONTROL_LIST == 1.
Internal use only. Handles must refer to valid task and kernel object.

functions.name: vRevokeAccessToKernelObject
functions.signature: void vRevokeAccessToKernelObject(TaskHandle_t xExternalTaskHandle, int32_t lExternalKernelObjectHandle)
functions.description: Internal (MPU ACL v2): revokes a task’s access to a kernel object by external handle.
requirements: Same as vGrantAccessToKernelObject.
Internal use only.

functions.name: vPortGrantAccessToKernelObject
functions.signature: void vPortGrantAccessToKernelObject(TaskHandle_t xInternalTaskHandle, int32_t lInternalIndexOfKernelObject)
functions.description: Port-internal (MPU ACL v2): grants access using internal kernel object index.
requirements: Same configuration as ACL functions.
Internal/port use only.

functions.name: vPortRevokeAccessToKernelObject
functions.signature: void vPortRevokeAccessToKernelObject(TaskHandle_t xInternalTaskHandle, int32_t lInternalIndexOfKernelObject)
functions.description: Port-internal (MPU ACL v2): revokes access using internal kernel object index.
requirements: Same configuration as ACL functions.
Internal/port use only.

functions.name: xQueueCreate
functions.signature: QueueHandle_t xQueueCreate( UBaseType_t uxQueueLength, UBaseType_t uxItemSize );
functions.description: Creates a new queue using dynamic allocation and returns its handle. Use to create a queue that stores uxQueueLength items of fixed size uxItemSize bytes (items are copied into the queue).
requirements: Must include FreeRTOS.h before queue.h (enforced by header).
configSUPPORT_DYNAMIC_ALLOCATION must be 1 at build time (macro expands to xQueueGenericCreate).
uxQueueLength is the maximum number of items the queue can contain; must be greater than 0 for non-zero item size queues.
uxItemSize is the size in bytes of each item and must match the size used by send/receive operations.
Returns NULL if allocation fails; caller must check for NULL before use.

functions.name: xQueueCreateStatic
functions.signature: QueueHandle_t xQueueCreateStatic( UBaseType_t uxQueueLength, UBaseType_t uxItemSize, uint8_t * pucQueueStorage, StaticQueue_t * pxQueueBuffer );
functions.description: Creates a new queue using application-supplied static memory buffers and returns its handle. Avoids dynamic allocation.
requirements: configSUPPORT_STATIC_ALLOCATION must be 1 at build time (macro expands to xQueueGenericCreateStatic).
If uxItemSize != 0 then pucQueueStorage must point to a buffer of at least (uxQueueLength * uxItemSize) bytes; if uxItemSize == 0 then pucQueueStorage may be NULL.
pxQueueBuffer must point to a valid StaticQueue_t to hold the queue control structure; function returns NULL if pxQueueBuffer is NULL.
uxItemSize must match the size used by subsequent send/receive operations.
uxQueueLength defines the maximum number of items the queue can contain.

functions.name: xQueueGetStaticBuffers
functions.signature: BaseType_t xQueueGetStaticBuffers( QueueHandle_t xQueue, uint8_t ** ppucQueueStorage, StaticQueue_t ** ppxStaticQueue );
functions.description: Retrieves the pointers to the static storage buffers (item storage area and control structure) of a statically created queue.
requirements: configSUPPORT_STATIC_ALLOCATION must be 1 at build time (macro expands to xQueueGenericGetStaticBuffers).
xQueue must be a valid handle to a statically created queue.
ppucQueueStorage and ppxStaticQueue must be valid writable pointers to receive the addresses.
Returns pdTRUE on success, pdFALSE otherwise; caller should check return value before using outputs.

functions.name: xQueueSendToFront
functions.signature: BaseType_t xQueueSendToFront( QueueHandle_t xQueue, const void * pvItemToQueue, TickType_t xTicksToWait );
functions.description: Posts an item to the front of a queue (higher priority placement). Copies uxItemSize bytes from pvItemToQueue into the queue.
requirements: Must not be called from an interrupt service routine; use xQueueSendToFrontFromISR in ISRs.
xQueue must be a valid queue handle.
pvItemToQueue must point to at least uxItemSize bytes matching the queue's item size.
xTicksToWait is a block time in ticks; if 0 and the queue is full, returns immediately.
Returns pdPASS on success, errQUEUE_FULL if the queue remains full.

functions.name: xQueueSendToBack
functions.signature: BaseType_t xQueueSendToBack( QueueHandle_t xQueue, const void * pvItemToQueue, TickType_t xTicksToWait );
functions.description: Posts an item to the back of a queue. Copies uxItemSize bytes from pvItemToQueue into the queue.
requirements: Must not be called from an interrupt service routine; use xQueueSendToBackFromISR in ISRs.
xQueue must be a valid queue handle.
pvItemToQueue must point to at least uxItemSize bytes matching the queue's item size.
xTicksToWait is a block time in ticks; if 0 and the queue is full, returns immediately.
Returns pdPASS on success, errQUEUE_FULL otherwise.

functions.name: xQueueSend
functions.signature: BaseType_t xQueueSend( QueueHandle_t xQueue, const void * pvItemToQueue, TickType_t xTicksToWait );
functions.description: Backwards-compatible macro equivalent to xQueueSendToBack; posts an item to the back of a queue by copying from pvItemToQueue.
requirements: Must not be called from an interrupt service routine; use xQueueSendFromISR in ISRs.
xQueue must be a valid queue handle.
pvItemToQueue must point to at least uxItemSize bytes matching the queue's item size.
xTicksToWait is a block time in ticks; if 0 and the queue is full, returns immediately.
Returns pdPASS on success, errQUEUE_FULL otherwise.

functions.name: xQueueOverwrite
functions.signature: BaseType_t xQueueOverwrite( QueueHandle_t xQueue, const void * pvItemToQueue );
functions.description: Posts an item to a length-1 queue, overwriting any existing item if the queue is full. Copies uxItemSize bytes from pvItemToQueue.
requirements: Queue must have a length of 1; using on longer queues is not supported and may assert if configASSERT() is defined.
Must not be called from an interrupt service routine; use xQueueOverwriteFromISR in ISRs.
xQueue must be a valid queue handle.
pvItemToQueue must point to at least uxItemSize bytes matching the queue's item size.
Always returns pdPASS (overwrites if full).

functions.name: xQueueGenericSend
functions.signature: BaseType_t xQueueGenericSend( QueueHandle_t xQueue, const void * const pvItemToQueue, TickType_t xTicksToWait, const BaseType_t xCopyPosition );
functions.description: Underlying API to post an item to a queue, placing it at the front or back per xCopyPosition. Copies uxItemSize bytes from pvItemToQueue.
requirements: Prefer using xQueueSend/xQueueSendToFront/xQueueSendToBack macros instead of calling directly.
Must not be called from an interrupt service routine; use xQueueGenericSendFromISR in ISRs.
xQueue must be a valid queue handle.
pvItemToQueue must point to a buffer of at least uxItemSize bytes.
xTicksToWait is the maximum block time in ticks; 0 for no block.
xCopyPosition must be queueSEND_TO_BACK, queueSEND_TO_FRONT, or queueOVERWRITE (per usage).
Returns pdPASS on success, errQUEUE_FULL if the queue remains full.

functions.name: xQueuePeek
functions.signature: BaseType_t xQueuePeek( QueueHandle_t xQueue, void * const pvBuffer, TickType_t xTicksToWait );
functions.description: Copies the next item from a queue into pvBuffer without removing it from the queue.
requirements: Must not be used in an interrupt service routine; use xQueuePeekFromISR in ISRs.
xQueue must be a valid queue handle.
pvBuffer must point to a buffer of at least uxItemSize bytes.
xTicksToWait is a block time in ticks; returns immediately if 0 and queue is empty.
Returns pdPASS on success, errQUEUE_EMPTY if no item was available within the block time.

functions.name: xQueuePeekFromISR
functions.signature: BaseType_t xQueuePeekFromISR( QueueHandle_t xQueue, void * const pvBuffer );
functions.description: ISR-safe version of xQueuePeek; copies the next item from a queue into pvBuffer without removing it.
requirements: May be called only from an ISR context or critical section where ISR-safe APIs are permitted.
xQueue must be a valid queue handle.
pvBuffer must point to a buffer of at least uxItemSize bytes.
Returns pdPASS if an item was copied, otherwise pdFAIL.

functions.name: xQueueReceive
functions.signature: BaseType_t xQueueReceive( QueueHandle_t xQueue, void * const pvBuffer, TickType_t xTicksToWait );
functions.description: Receives (and removes) the next item from a queue into pvBuffer, blocking up to xTicksToWait if empty.
requirements: Must not be called from an interrupt service routine; use xQueueReceiveFromISR in ISRs.
xQueue must be a valid queue handle.
pvBuffer must point to a buffer of at least uxItemSize bytes.
xTicksToWait is a block time in ticks; if 0 and empty, returns immediately.
Returns pdPASS on success, errQUEUE_EMPTY otherwise.

functions.name: uxQueueMessagesWaiting
functions.signature: UBaseType_t uxQueueMessagesWaiting( const QueueHandle_t xQueue );
functions.description: Returns the number of items currently stored in a queue.
requirements: xQueue must be a valid queue handle.

functions.name: uxQueueSpacesAvailable
functions.signature: UBaseType_t uxQueueSpacesAvailable( const QueueHandle_t xQueue );
functions.description: Returns the number of free item slots in a queue (capacity minus current occupancy).
requirements: xQueue must be a valid queue handle.

functions.name: vQueueDelete
functions.signature: void vQueueDelete( QueueHandle_t xQueue );
functions.description: Deletes a queue, freeing memory used for items and control structures (if dynamically allocated).
requirements: xQueue must be a valid queue handle to a queue, semaphore, or mutex to delete.
After deletion, the handle must not be used.

functions.name: xQueueSendToFrontFromISR
functions.signature: BaseType_t xQueueSendToFrontFromISR( QueueHandle_t xQueue, const void * pvItemToQueue, BaseType_t * pxHigherPriorityTaskWoken );
functions.description: ISR-safe macro to post an item to the front of a queue. Copies uxItemSize bytes from pvItemToQueue. Sets *pxHigherPriorityTaskWoken to pdTRUE if a higher-priority task was unblocked.
requirements: May be called from an ISR context.
xQueue must be a valid queue handle.
pvItemToQueue must point to a buffer of at least uxItemSize bytes.
pxHigherPriorityTaskWoken must be a valid pointer; if set to pdTRUE, a yield-from-ISR should be requested by the caller as per port macros.
Returns pdPASS on success, errQUEUE_FULL otherwise.

functions.name: xQueueSendToBackFromISR
functions.signature: BaseType_t xQueueSendToBackFromISR( QueueHandle_t xQueue, const void * pvItemToQueue, BaseType_t * pxHigherPriorityTaskWoken );
functions.description: ISR-safe macro to post an item to the back of a queue. Copies uxItemSize bytes from pvItemToQueue. Sets *pxHigherPriorityTaskWoken if a higher-priority task is unblocked.
requirements: May be called from an ISR context.
xQueue must be a valid queue handle.
pvItemToQueue must point to a buffer of at least uxItemSize bytes.
pxHigherPriorityTaskWoken must be a valid pointer; if set to pdTRUE, caller should request a context switch using the appropriate port macro.
Returns pdPASS on success, errQUEUE_FULL otherwise.

functions.name: xQueueOverwriteFromISR
functions.signature: BaseType_t xQueueOverwriteFromISR( QueueHandle_t xQueue, const void * pvItemToQueue, BaseType_t * pxHigherPriorityTaskWoken );
functions.description: ISR-safe macro to post an item to a length-1 queue, overwriting any existing item. Copies uxItemSize bytes from pvItemToQueue.
requirements: Queue must have a length of 1.
May be called from an ISR context.
xQueue must be a valid queue handle.
pvItemToQueue must point to a buffer of at least uxItemSize bytes.
pxHigherPriorityTaskWoken must be a valid pointer; if set to pdTRUE, caller should request a context switch.
Always returns pdPASS (overwrites if full).

functions.name: xQueueSendFromISR
functions.signature: BaseType_t xQueueSendFromISR( QueueHandle_t xQueue, const void * pvItemToQueue, BaseType_t * pxHigherPriorityTaskWoken );
functions.description: Backward-compatible ISR-safe macro equivalent to xQueueSendToBackFromISR; posts an item to the back of a queue and optionally indicates a need to yield.
requirements: May be called from an ISR context.
xQueue must be a valid queue handle.
pvItemToQueue must point to a buffer of at least uxItemSize bytes.
pxHigherPriorityTaskWoken must be a valid pointer; if set to pdTRUE, caller should request a context switch.
Returns pdPASS on success, errQUEUE_FULL otherwise.

functions.name: xQueueGenericSendFromISR
functions.signature: BaseType_t xQueueGenericSendFromISR( QueueHandle_t xQueue, const void * const pvItemToQueue, BaseType_t * const pxHigherPriorityTaskWoken, const BaseType_t xCopyPosition );
functions.description: Underlying ISR-safe API to post an item to the front or back of a queue (per xCopyPosition). Copies uxItemSize bytes and reports if a higher-priority task was unblocked.
requirements: May be called from an ISR context.
xQueue must be a valid queue handle.
pvItemToQueue must point to a buffer of at least uxItemSize bytes.
pxHigherPriorityTaskWoken must be a valid pointer; if set to pdTRUE, caller should request a context switch prior to exiting the ISR.
xCopyPosition must be queueSEND_TO_BACK, queueSEND_TO_FRONT, or queueOVERWRITE (per usage).
Returns pdPASS on success, errQUEUE_FULL otherwise.

functions.name: xQueueGiveFromISR
functions.signature: BaseType_t xQueueGiveFromISR( QueueHandle_t xQueue, BaseType_t * const pxHigherPriorityTaskWoken );
functions.description: ISR-safe helper used by semaphores to 'give' without copying data. Unblocks a task waiting to take if possible and sets *pxHigherPriorityTaskWoken accordingly.
requirements: May be called from an ISR context.
xQueue must be a valid semaphore/mutex/queue handle as appropriate for giving semantics.
pxHigherPriorityTaskWoken must be a valid pointer; if set to pdTRUE, caller should request a context switch.
Return value indicates success (pdPASS) or failure (pdFAIL/implementation-defined). Exact conditions depend on semaphore state (details not documented here).

functions.name: xQueueReceiveFromISR
functions.signature: BaseType_t xQueueReceiveFromISR( QueueHandle_t xQueue, void * const pvBuffer, BaseType_t * const pxHigherPriorityTaskWoken );
functions.description: Receives an item from a queue from ISR context, copying it into pvBuffer and optionally indicating that a higher-priority task was unblocked.
requirements: May be called from an ISR context.
xQueue must be a valid queue handle.
pvBuffer must point to a buffer of at least uxItemSize bytes.
pxHigherPriorityTaskWoken must be a valid pointer; if set to pdTRUE, caller should request a context switch.
Returns pdPASS on success, otherwise pdFAIL.

functions.name: xQueueIsQueueEmptyFromISR
functions.signature: BaseType_t xQueueIsQueueEmptyFromISR( const QueueHandle_t xQueue );
functions.description: ISR-safe utility that returns pdTRUE if the queue is empty, otherwise pdFALSE.
requirements: May be called from an ISR context or within a critical section.
xQueue must be a valid queue handle.

functions.name: xQueueIsQueueFullFromISR
functions.signature: BaseType_t xQueueIsQueueFullFromISR( const QueueHandle_t xQueue );
functions.description: ISR-safe utility that returns pdTRUE if the queue is full, otherwise pdFALSE.
requirements: May be called from an ISR context or within a critical section.
xQueue must be a valid queue handle.

functions.name: uxQueueMessagesWaitingFromISR
functions.signature: UBaseType_t uxQueueMessagesWaitingFromISR( const QueueHandle_t xQueue );
functions.description: ISR-safe utility that returns the number of messages currently waiting in the queue.
requirements: May be called from an ISR context or within a critical section.
xQueue must be a valid queue handle.

functions.name: xQueueCRSendFromISR
functions.signature: BaseType_t xQueueCRSendFromISR( QueueHandle_t xQueue, const void * pvItemToQueue, BaseType_t xCoRoutinePreviouslyWoken );
functions.description: Co-routine support function to send from ISR context. Intended to be called via co-routine macros, not directly from application code.
requirements: configUSE_CO_ROUTINES must be 1 at build time.
Should be invoked via co-routine macro wrappers (per header note).
xQueue must be a valid queue handle.
pvItemToQueue must point to at least uxItemSize bytes.
xCoRoutinePreviouslyWoken is used per co-routine scheduling semantics (details not provided here).

functions.name: xQueueCRReceiveFromISR
functions.signature: BaseType_t xQueueCRReceiveFromISR( QueueHandle_t xQueue, void * pvBuffer, BaseType_t * pxTaskWoken );
functions.description: Co-routine support function to receive from ISR context. Intended to be called via co-routine macros.
requirements: configUSE_CO_ROUTINES must be 1 at build time.
Should be invoked via co-routine macro wrappers (per header note).
xQueue must be a valid queue handle.
pvBuffer must point to at least uxItemSize bytes.
pxTaskWoken must be a valid pointer to receive wake information.

functions.name: xQueueCRSend
functions.signature: BaseType_t xQueueCRSend( QueueHandle_t xQueue, const void * pvItemToQueue, TickType_t xTicksToWait );
functions.description: Co-routine support function to send to a queue, potentially blocking for up to xTicksToWait. Intended to be used via co-routine macros.
requirements: configUSE_CO_ROUTINES must be 1 at build time.
Should be invoked via co-routine macro wrappers (per header note).
xQueue must be a valid queue handle.
pvItemToQueue must point to at least uxItemSize bytes.
xTicksToWait is a block time in ticks for co-routines.

functions.name: xQueueCRReceive
functions.signature: BaseType_t xQueueCRReceive( QueueHandle_t xQueue, void * pvBuffer, TickType_t xTicksToWait );
functions.description: Co-routine support function to receive from a queue, potentially blocking for up to xTicksToWait. Intended to be used via co-routine macros.
requirements: configUSE_CO_ROUTINES must be 1 at build time.
Should be invoked via co-routine macro wrappers (per header note).
xQueue must be a valid queue handle.
pvBuffer must point to at least uxItemSize bytes.
xTicksToWait is a block time in ticks for co-routines.

functions.name: xQueueCreateMutex
functions.signature: QueueHandle_t xQueueCreateMutex( const uint8_t ucQueueType );
functions.description: Internal helper to create a mutex or recursive mutex (depending on ucQueueType). Public code should use xSemaphoreCreateMutex or related APIs instead.
requirements: Intended for internal use; callers should prefer documented semaphore APIs.
ucQueueType selects the mutex type (values match queueQUEUE_TYPE_* definitions).
Returns NULL on failure; caller must check before use.

functions.name: xQueueCreateMutexStatic
functions.signature: QueueHandle_t xQueueCreateMutexStatic( const uint8_t ucQueueType, StaticQueue_t * pxStaticQueue );
functions.description: Internal helper to create a mutex using application-provided StaticQueue_t storage.

pxStaticQueue must be a valid pointer to storage for the mutex control structure.
ucQueueType selects the mutex type (matches queueQUEUE_TYPE_*).

functions.name: xQueueCreateCountingSemaphore
functions.signature: QueueHandle_t xQueueCreateCountingSemaphore( const UBaseType_t uxMaxCount, const UBaseType_t uxInitialCount );
functions.description: Creates a counting semaphore with a maximum and initial count using dynamic allocation.

functions.name: xQueueCreateCountingSemaphoreStatic
functions.signature: QueueHandle_t xQueueCreateCountingSemaphoreStatic( const UBaseType_t uxMaxCount, const UBaseType_t uxInitialCount, StaticQueue_t * pxStaticQueue );
functions.description: Creates a counting semaphore using application-provided StaticQueue_t storage.
requirements: configUSE_COUNTING_SEMAPHORES and configSUPPORT_STATIC_ALLOCATION must be 1 at build time.
pxStaticQueue must be a valid pointer to storage for the semaphore control structure.
uxInitialCount must be <= uxMaxCount (inferred standard semaphore requirement; explicit text not present).
Returns NULL on failure; caller must check.

functions.name: xQueueSemaphoreTake
functions.signature: BaseType_t xQueueSemaphoreTake( QueueHandle_t xQueue, TickType_t xTicksToWait );
functions.description: Internal helper to take (acquire) a semaphore or mutex, optionally blocking up to xTicksToWait.
requirements: Intended for internal use; public code should use xSemaphoreTake or related APIs.
xQueue must be a valid semaphore/mutex handle.
xTicksToWait is the maximum block time in ticks; 0 for no block.
Returns pdPASS on success; otherwise appropriate failure code.

functions.name: xQueueGetMutexHolder
functions.signature: TaskHandle_t xQueueGetMutexHolder( QueueHandle_t xSemaphore );
functions.description: Returns the handle of the task that currently holds the given mutex.

functions.description: ISR-safe variant that returns the handle of the task that holds the given mutex.
requirements: configUSE_MUTEXES and INCLUDE_xSemaphoreGetMutexHolder must be 1 at build time.
May be called from an ISR context.
xSemaphore must be a valid mutex handle.
May return NULL if the mutex is not held.

functions.name: xQueueTakeMutexRecursive
functions.signature: BaseType_t xQueueTakeMutexRecursive( QueueHandle_t xMutex, TickType_t xTicksToWait );
functions.description: Internal helper to take a recursive mutex, optionally blocking up to xTicksToWait.

xTicksToWait is the maximum block time in ticks.

functions.name: xQueueGiveMutexRecursive
functions.signature: BaseType_t xQueueGiveMutexRecursive( QueueHandle_t xMutex );
functions.description: Internal helper to give (release) a recursive mutex.
requirements: Intended for internal use; prefer xSemaphoreGiveRecursive in application code.
xMutex must be a valid recursive mutex handle owned by the calling task.
Returns pdPASS on success; otherwise failure.

functions.name: xQueueReset
functions.signature: BaseType_t xQueueReset( QueueHandle_t xQueue );
functions.description: Resets a queue back to its original empty state. Return value is obsolete and always pdPASS.
requirements: xQueue must be a valid queue handle.
Must not be called from a context where resetting could violate queue usage (general FreeRTOS constraint; explicit ISR rules not stated here).

functions.name: vQueueAddToRegistry
functions.signature: void vQueueAddToRegistry( QueueHandle_t xQueue, const char * pcQueueName );
functions.description: Adds a queue/semaphore/mutex handle to the kernel’s queue registry for debugger visibility, associating it with a persistent name string.

pcQueueName must point to a persistent string (global/ROM/Flash), not stack-allocated.
If called multiple times with the same xQueue, the most recent name is stored.

functions.name: vQueueUnregisterQueue
functions.signature: void vQueueUnregisterQueue( QueueHandle_t xQueue );
functions.description: Removes a queue/semaphore/mutex handle from the queue registry.
requirements: configQUEUE_REGISTRY_SIZE must be > 0 at build time.
xQueue must be a valid handle that was previously added to the registry.

functions.name: pcQueueGetName
functions.signature: const char * pcQueueGetName( QueueHandle_t xQueue );
functions.description: Looks up and returns the registered name for a queue/semaphore/mutex handle, or NULL if not registered.
requirements: configQUEUE_REGISTRY_SIZE must be > 0 at build time.
xQueue must be a valid handle.

functions.name: xQueueGenericCreate
functions.signature: QueueHandle_t xQueueGenericCreate( const UBaseType_t uxQueueLength, const UBaseType_t uxItemSize, const uint8_t ucQueueType );
functions.description: Internal generic creator using dynamic allocation for queues and queue-based objects (e.g., semaphores/mutexes).
requirements: configSUPPORT_DYNAMIC_ALLOCATION must be 1 at build time.
uxQueueLength defines the capacity (for queues/semaphores).
uxItemSize defines item size in bytes (0 for semaphores).
ucQueueType must match queueQUEUE_TYPE_* values.
